belay.P1 – First Flight: Past the chute, the belay sits up and to the left, with the belayer under a right-facing corner.
belay.P2: Bolted anchor beneath a clean left-facing corner, just above the short slab that follows the roof.
belay.P4: Bolted station on a small ledge at the end of the arete.
belay.P5: Bolted belay where the wall ends, with a tree rappel anchor off to climber's left.
